name: smwmusic-live-a-live-kiss-of-jealousy
title: Live A Live - Kiss of Jealousy
description:
An epic (and somewhat Spanish-sounding?) theme from Live A Live. Composed by Yoko Shimomura.

It may be fitting for action-packed areas, such as battle sequences or tough levels. Personally, I also get the vibe from this that it may make for a good title screen theme.

Requested by Infinity.
